title: Beijing Sub-center's First OPC Carnival Songzhuang Season Concludes: AIGC Creation and Copyright Closed Loop Fully Takes Shape
excerpt: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the “One Person Company” (OPC) is becoming one of the most closely watched innovative business
content_html:
With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the “One Person Company” (OPC) is becoming one of the most closely watched innovative business models in the digital content industry. Recently, the first OPC Carnival · Songzhuang Season at the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center officially came to a close in Beijing. With the core theme “One Person, One Team · Building a Nest Through Art,” the event focused comprehensively on community building, industry matchmaking, and the transformation of outcomes, attracting widespread attention across the industry.

National-Level Quality Credibility Empowerment Lays a Solid Compliance Foundation for Digital Cultural Creativity

During the event, the “National Commercial Quality Monitoring Service Platform Quality Co-construction Warehouse” was officially announced. This move marks that Songzhuang’s art and cultural creative ecosystem has officially joined a national-level quality credibility empowerment system.

By building institutional support pathways that cover establishing trust through quality, setting rules for copyright, setting standards for premium works, and strengthening the foundation through talent, Innovation Valley will, in the future, rely on Songzhuang as its base and extend its reach nationwide. It formally invites AIGC creators, OPC principals, and brands to join, jointly participate in national brand quality co-construction, and comprehensively drive quality upgrades for local specialty products and digital cultural content.

Building a Full Industry-Chain Closed Loop and Launching a Track to Nurture Young Creators
